verdict.rationale: Phaser is distributed via npm with substantial adoption (263k weekly downloads), and a CLI offers official project templates and demo games. A programmatic examples index exists, and Phaser Editor bundles pixel-art, tilemap and atlas editors plus SFX generation. These are ready-made starting points and tools, but none of them is an asset store or a third-party plugin marketplace. Missing for 10: any documented asset store or marketplace for models/art, evidence of a third-party plugin ecosystem or registry, and independent corroboration of ecosystem breadth.
